map.年度培训规划排序，优先投入高杠杆主题。: Rank the annual training plan and invest first in the highest-leverage topics.
map.按缺口分析定需求，再评估计划可行性与训后效果。: Identify needs through a gap analysis, then assess plan feasibility and post-training effect.
map.柯氏四级（反应/学习/行为/结果）打分合成培训 ROI。: Combine the four Kirkpatrick levels (reaction / learning / behaviour / results) into a training ROI.
map.结合训后测评、上级评分与业务指标（如差错率下降）多源印证，单看满意度易虚高。: Corroborate across multiple sources - post-training assessment, supervisor ratings and business metrics such as a drop in error rate; satisfaction alone is easily inflated.
map.绩效差距、胜任力模型缺口与员工调研三方交汇处最该优先排课。: Sessions should be scheduled first where performance gaps, competency model gaps and employee survey results all converge.
map.输入培训前后能力评分与参训情况，按柯氏四级评估模型评价反应、学习、行为与结果层培: Enter pre- and post-training competency scores and attendance, then evaluate training effect across the reaction, learning, behaviour and results levels with the Kirkpatrick model. Useful for HR training reviews.
map.输入培训前后能力评分和参训情况，按柯氏四级评估模型评价培训效果: Enter pre- and post-training competency scores and attendance, then evaluate training effect with the Kirkpatrick four-level model
map.需求从哪来？: Where do the needs come from?
map.：某课训后 3 月行为改变率仅 20%，低于目标 50%，建议改实操占比。: : three months after a course the behaviour change rate was only 20%, below the 50% target, so raise the share of hands-on practice.
map.：需求紧迫 5.5、计划可行 7.8、训后效果 8.5，按权重合成 → 工具给出: : urgency of need 5.5, plan feasibility 7.8, post-training effect 8.5, combined by weights -> the tool gives an overall 7.4, and if it is above the threshold the project is approved.
